gloss: to dig up; to unearth; to uncover

definitions.explanation: To excavate something from the ground.

definitions.gloss: to uncover; to discover; to bring to light
definitions.explanation: To find or reveal something that was hidden or forgotten.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}で{古|ふる}い{硬貨|こうか}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こした。
examples.english: I dug up old coins in the garden.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{記録|きろく}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こして{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I dug up past records and investigated.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{才能|さいのう}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こすのが{私|わたし}の{仕事|しごと}だ。
examples.english: My job is to uncover new talent.

examples.japanese: {畑|はたけ}で{石|いし}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こした。
examples.english: I dug up a stone in the field.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}で{古|ふる}い{土器|どき}が{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こされた。
examples.english: Old pottery was unearthed at the construction site.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{伝統|でんとう}{文化|ぶんか}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こして{観光|かんこう}に{活|い}かす。
examples.english: Unearthing local traditional culture and using it for tourism.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす → {掘|ほ}り{起|お}こさない (negative)
・{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす → {掘|ほ}り{起|お}こして (te-form)
・{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす → {掘|ほ}り{起|お}こした (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {掘|ほ}る (to dig) + {起|お}こす (to raise up)

USAGE:
・{遺跡|いせき}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす (to excavate ruins)
・{真実|しんじつ}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす (to uncover the truth)
・{需要|じゅよう}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす (to discover/create demand)
・{昔|むかし}の{記憶|きおく}を{掘|ほ}り{起|お}こす (to dig up old memories)
